questions.question: The ratio of monthly incomes of A and B is 3 : 4 and the ratio of their monthly savings is 7 : 6, If the income of A is equal to twice the expenditure of B, then what is the ratio of the expenditures of A and B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of monthly income of A and B is 3 : 4

Ratio of monthly savings of A and B is 7 : 6

Income of A = 2 × Expenditure of B

**Concept used:**

Savings = Income - Expenditure

**Calculation:**

Let the monthly incomes of A and B are 3x and 4x

Their monthly savings are 7y and 6y

According to the question

3x = 2 × (4x – 6y)

⇒ 3x = 8x – 12y

⇒ 8x – 3x = 12y

⇒ 5x = 12y

⇒ x : y = 12 : 5

Income of A = 3x = 3 × 12 = 36

Income of B = 4x = 4 × 12 = 48

Savings of A = 7y = 7 × 5 = 35

Savings of B = 6y = 6 × 5 = 30

Expenditure of A = 36 – 35 = 1

Expenditure of B = 48 – 30 = 18

**The ratio of expenditure of A to than that of B is 1 : 18**

**Note: **This question has been asked in the previous year exam and we have changed the options to give answers accordingly

Anita spends 68% of her monthly income. If her monthly income increases by 40% and the expenditure increase by 30%, then by what percent does her saving increase?
questions.solution:
Let income of Anita Rs. 100

Expenditure of Anita = 100 × (68/100) = 68

Savings of Anita = 100 – 68 = 32

New income of Anita = 100 × (140/100) = 140

New expenditure of Anita = 68 × (130/100) = 88.4

questions.question: The sides of a triangular park are 36m, 105m and 111m. What is the cost of leveling the park at Rs. 8.40 per m² ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sides of a triangular park are 36m, 105m and 111m

the cost of leveling the park at Rs. 8.40 per m² 

**Calculation:**

The sides of the triangle are 36 m, 105 m and 111 m, then

(111)² = 36² + 105²

12321 = 1296 + 11025

12321 = 12321

Now, we can say that the given triangle is right-angled.

Area of right angled triangle is = (1/2) × Base × Height = (1/2) × 36 × 105 = 1890 m²

Cost of levelling 1 m² = Rs. 8.40

Cost of levelling 1890 m² = Rs. 8.40 × 1890 = Rs. 15876

questions.question: The average population of city B for all the given years is what percent less than the total population of city A for 2014, 2016 and 2018?
questions.solution:
Total population of city B for all years = 48 + 50 + 55 + 60 + 65 + 64 = 342

Average population of city B for all years = 342/6 = 57

Total population of city A for 2014, 2016 and 2018 = 44 + 52 + 54 = 150

Required percentage = [(150 – 57) /150] × 100 = 62%

questions.question: The average of 61 numbers is 54. The average of the first 31 numbers is 50.6 and that of the last 31 numbers is 60.4. If the 31st number is excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
Average of 61 numbers is 54

Sum of 61 numbers is 54 × 61 = 3294

Average of first 31 numbers = 50.6

Sum of first 31 numbers = 50.6 × 31 = 1568.6

Average of last 31 numbers is = 60.4

Sum of last 31 numbers is = 60.4 × 31 = 1872.4

According to the question

31st number is 1872.4 + 1568.6 – 3294 = 147

Sum of 60 number 3294 – 147 = 3147

Average of 60 numbers = 3147/60 = 52.45

questions.question: A dealer allows a 36% discount on the marked price of an article and still gains 28%. If the cost price of the article is reduced by 10%, how much discount percent should he allow now so as to get the same percentage of profit as before?
questions.solution:
Let CP of the article be Rs. 100

SP of the article = 100 × 128/100 = 128

MP of the article = 128 × 100/64 = 200

New CP of the article = 100 × 90/100 = 90

New SP of the article = 90 × 128/100 = 115.2

Discount percentage = [(200 – 115.2) /200] × 100 = 42.4%

questions.question: When the price of sugar increased by 28%, a family reduced its consumption per month such that the expenditure on sugar was only 12% more than before. If 10 kg sugar was consumed per month before the price rise, then what was the new consumption?
questions.solution:
Let the price of sugar be Rs. 100x

Price of sugar after increment of price = 100 × 128 / 100 = Rs. 128x

The person wants to increase his expenditure only by = 100 × (112 / 100) = Rs. 112x

Present price of 10 kg = Rs. 128x

Per rupee Consumption = 10 / 128x

Consumption of sugar in Rs. 112x = (10 / 128x) × 112x = 8.75 kg

**∴ New consumption of sugar is 8.75 kg**
